description: Whole chains of mice(data, m, maxit, ..., seed). start: imp of mice(maxit = 0) with the same seed, per variable with where-cells its rows (0-based) and per chain the values. kind: 'deterministic' (nothing drawn after the start), 'scripted' (m = 1; draws: chisq with chisq_df, normals, uniforms, in the order given as [pool, count] pairs) or 'spy' (m = 1; calls: what mice.impute.spy received at every call, x after remove.lindep). args: the arguments of mice() (method a string or one per column; predictor_matrix, visit_sequence null when not given; where only when given, a keyword or cols and values, a list of rows). maxit: one value per step, the first for mice(), each further one for mice.mids(). steps: after each step imp, the completed data per chain, chain_mean and chain_var (numeric variables R imputes, iteration x chain), logged_events, iteration and the values drawn from each pool so far (scripted). lost_observed (only in cases that lose observed values): per variable the number of observed where-cells that are NA in the completed data of some chain, after the start and after each step.
